hypotheses.claim: The existing ClayCode G9 semantic basis is sufficient to represent the FRANK v0.1 adaptive visual learner control state without a new dedicated language primitive.
hypotheses.mechanism: Use ordinary typed/versioned records plus existing epistemic states, epochs, rules, provenance sets and deterministic semantic identity for training examples, classifier versions, candidate/current/LKG state, budgets, open-set outcomes and replay hooks.
support: current G9 already provides records, Set/Ordered, Epoch, provenance, Delta, capability/effect separation and deterministic identity concepts
hypotheses.falsifier: A normative ClayCode parser/typed-IR/type-effect/evaluator/compiler test demonstrates that one required learner law cannot be expressed or preserved without an escape hatch or a new semantic primitive.
hypotheses.next_test: Compile CLAYCODE_MVC_STATE_CANDIDATE.clay through the normative BASE compiler stack and run the proxy corpus against the generated executable semantics.

hypotheses.claim: A generic versioned candidate/current/last-known-good state machine plus feature-backbone compatibility is enough to make adaptive learner promotion and rollback deterministic and replayable across H1 and H2.
hypotheses.mechanism: Candidate updates are shadow state; promotion atomically moves current to LKG and candidate to current only after evaluation and backbone-compatibility gates; rollback restores LKG by exact version identity.
support: owner-fixed FRANK v0.1 adaptive visual learning directive
hypotheses.falsifier: H1/H2 differential replay finds a required learner transition whose observable semantics cannot be captured by current/candidate/LKG plus explicit event/provenance/version state.
hypotheses.next_test: Freeze H1 event/state schema, then differential replay identical promotion/rejection/rollback/backbone-change traces in H2.

hypotheses.claim: Frozen visual features with prototype and/or lightweight linear readout are a credible first implementation family for the user-adaptive visual learner under the v0.1 resource constraints.
hypotheses.mechanism: Keep the feature backbone frozen and adapt only compact prototypes or a small linear head, preserving a cheap rollbackable learner surface.
hypotheses.falsifier: MVC-E1..E7 on project hardware/data show prototypes/linear readout cannot meet frozen resource, retention, open-set and personalization thresholds while a different bounded learner can.
hypotheses.next_test: H1 MVC-0 vs MVC-1 benchmark under frozen acceptance thresholds.

hypotheses.claim: Treating UNKNOWN, AMBIGUOUS and CONFLICT as first-class semantic outcomes rather than coercing them to known classes will reduce unsafe false-familiar routing without preventing personalization gains.
hypotheses.mechanism: Open-set/conflict outcomes trigger deeper perception while calibrated KNOWN_HIGH_CONFIDENCE alone may take the familiar fast path; sensor provenance remains attached in all cases.
support: FRANK v0.1 adaptive visual learning directive
open-world few-shot literature motivating explicit unknown handling
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched H1 tests show explicit open-set states provide no safety/task benefit and materially degrade resource or personalization performance relative to a calibrated alternative under the same false-familiarity ceiling.
hypotheses.next_test: MVC-E5 plus MVC-E6 with matched known/unknown lookalikes and routing-cost measurements.

counterhypotheses.claim: The generic G9 state basis is insufficient because learner promotion/replay requires dedicated transactional or model-version semantics that cannot be encoded safely through existing records/rules and runtime facilities.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Normative compiler/type-effect execution of candidate/current/LKG promotion plus crash/replay traces.

counterhypotheses.claim: Prototype/linear adaptation will not satisfy Frank-specific open-set and retention requirements under actual user distributions, so a different small learner family will be necessary.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: MVC-E2/E3/E5 under project-specific held-out and sequential-class data.

counterhypotheses.claim: Feature-backbone version changes are frequent enough that prototype/readout invalidation and migration cost erase the intended familiarity speedup.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: MVC-E7 plus long-horizon feature-version churn simulation and project-hardware measurement.
